string.text: Rifled barrel
Rifling the barrel can significantly improve shooting accuracy and increases the initial speed of the bullet, but makes it impossible to fire shotguns.
DTK
Installing a muzzle brake-compensator reduces the recoil felt by the shooter.
Tritium insert
Installing a luminous insert in the sighting device allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Anatomical handle
Provides the right hand with a more comfortable grip.
Heavy Duty Parts

Replacing standard parts from the main components of the weapon with analogues made of wear-resistant alloys allows you to extend the service life of the weapon and reduce the number of delays that occur during firing.
Light alloy parts
Replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts allows you to reduce the weight of the weapon.
Lightweight stock
Replacing a standard stock with a lighter one reduces the weight of the weapon.
Butt pad
Reduces the recoil felt by the shooter from a weapon shot.
High capacity magazine
Allows you to reduce the number of reloads in battle, increasing your chances of staying alive.
Refinement of the cartridge feeding mechanism
Allows you to reduce the number of delays that occur during the feeding of the next cartridge from the magazine into the chamber.
Chamber adjustment
Careful adjustment of parts and minimization of backlash allows for higher shooting accuracy.
Forcing USM
Allows the shooter to achieve a higher rate of fire when firing a weapon.
Lightweight handguard
Allows you to reduce the total weight of the weapon.
Soft release mechanism
Allows you to reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
Fitting mechanisms
Fitting and careful grinding of the main components helps to minimize backlash, which has a beneficial effect on the accuracy of firing.
